name: youtube-fetcher
title_zh: YouTube 视频开口前先落成带章节和出处的 Ma
tagline_zh: 丢个链接过去，字幕、创作者、章节、语言、出处一次收齐。不是聊天摘要，是能直接进 Obsidian 的档案级笔记。
tagline_en: Drop a URL, get captions, creator, chapters, language, and provenance in one note. Not a chat summary—an archival.
desc_en: Retrieve YouTube transcripts and subtitles, summarize or analyze what was said, or save an Obsidian-ready Markdown knowledge-base note with captions, creator metadata, chapters, language, and source provenance. Use for a YouTube URL or video ID when the request needs spoken content or an archival note. A bare YouTube link defaults to saving a note.
why_zh: 它把「看视频」变成「收档案」：字幕逐句保留，元数据齐全，来源可溯。适合要引用、要回查、要沉淀知识库的人。
why_en: It treats video as source material, not noise: verbatim captions, full metadata, traceable origin. Built for citing, revisiting.
limit_zh: 只认 YouTube 链接或视频 ID；无字幕或自动字幕关闭的视频拿不到内容。产物是 Markdown 笔记。
limit_en: YouTube links or IDs only; no transcript if captions are disabled. Output is a Markdown note—no summarization, no opinion, no semantic layer.
title_en: Turn a YouTube link into an Obsidian-ready Markdown note.
